description: This file implements a command-line UI manager ('MeshViewsMgr') for a Wi-Fi mesh network application. It manages UI state, handles external C library calls for network configuration, sets up timers, and processes user input events related to the mesh view.
external_files: C headers included via cgo: <stdio.h>, readline/readline.h, readline/history.h, em_cli_apis.h

classes.name: MeshViewsMgr
classes.description: A struct managing the UI workflow, timers, and network configurations for the mesh view application.

methods.name: newMeshSettings1
methods.description: Initializes a remote mesh setting by validating IP and port, then calling external C functions to set remote address.

methods.name: timerHandler
methods.description: Runs in a goroutine, periodically sends UI refresh and debug messages, and stops on quit signal.

methods.name: newMeshViewsMgr
methods.description: Factory function that creates and initializes a MeshViewsMgr instance, including setting up logs, C libraries, and timers.

methods.name: ActivateTimer
methods.description: Starts or stops the internal ticker based on network validity status.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Implements part of tea.Model interface; initializes the mesh view manager state.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Processes incoming UI events such as window resize and key presses, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the current mesh view for rendering.
